INSERT INTO push_subscriptions (user_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth, user_agent)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
        ON CONFLICT (endpoint) DO UPDATE
            SET user_id = EXCLUDED.user_id,
                p256dh = EXCLUDED.p256dh,
                auth = EXCLUDED.auth,
                user_agent = EXCLUDED.user_agent
